note: Real E2 mapping for the huayi properties-history schema (first real account data 2026-08-04). Unit and time semantics from official docs (help/1839, help/1844) and observed responses; missing-value semantics NOT yet confirmed, so blocked_semantics is the expected gate outcome until vendor/observation confirms how absent measurements are expressed.

heart_rate_bpm.time_semantics: ts is the measurement instant (ISO8601 with timezone); createTime is the platform ingestion time
heart_rate_bpm.value_semantics: device-estimated instantaneous heart rate; official docs express heart rate in bpm (help/1839)

respiratory_rate_bpm.time_semantics: ts is the measurement instant (ISO8601 with timezone); createTime is the platform ingestion time
respiratory_rate_bpm.value_semantics: device-estimated instantaneous breath rate; product parameters state 0-36 breaths/min

measurement_at.time_semantics: ISO8601 timestamp with +08:00 offset in observed responses
